title: mitracarpus squarrosus
intro: Mitracarpus squarrosus, commonly known as "Herrera's Powder Puff" or "Herrera's Powderflower", is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which aid in reducing fever, pain, and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Mitracarpus squarrosus include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antipyretic to reduce fever, and an analgesic to relieve pain, all of which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Mitracarpus squarrosus have been found to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
